question: Will Bitcoin close above $80,000 on September 17, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Spot is $79,338 (CoinGecko live, Sep 7 11:00 UTC) and the bar is $80,000 — the threshold sits 0.83% ABOVE spot, so a coin-flip framing is already slightly too generous. Realized daily log-vol over the last 14 CoinGecko closes is 1.96%; inverting Polymarket's September touch ladder (85K 47%, 90K 20%, 75K 55%, 70K 21%) and its Sep 7-13 78K market (72%) independently yields 1.92-2.04%/day with no discernible skew, so I treat sigma as well-identified and the crowd as directionally neutral. Over the 10.54 days to the 2026-09-17 UTC close that gives sigma_h = 6.4%; a driftless log random walk puts P at 0.448, and the martingale convexity term at 0.436. No prediction market prices this contract (all candidates are monthly-high/touch or year-end closes — near-miss, not anchors). Directional news is close to a wash: FOMC Sep 16 leans toward a 25bp hike (56-70% on FedWatch, hence mostly priced) and September seasonality plus a -9.85% YTD regime cut down, while price above all SMAs 7-90 and a +22% month cut up; the Sep 15 CLARITY cloture (needs 7 Democrats) is a fatter left tail than right. I land at 0.44 — just under the random walk because the gap to the strike is real and the tails are mildly left-skewed.

I take the left-lean: cloture failure is a discrete cited drawdown catalyst two days before the measured close, while success is procedural only and requires further negotiation, so the payoff is asymmetric even though the probability is unknown

disagreements.claim: Whether momentum (above all SMAs 7-90, +22-25% month, ETF inflows) or the drawdown regime (-9.85% YTD, 37% below ATH) should set the drift
disagreements.verdict: Treated as cancelling, consistent with all three runs; also unresolved in the evidence itself, which carries conflicting flow data (August +$3.5B inflows vs a reported -$236M September outflow as of Sep 1)

disagreements.claim: Some Polymarket touch rungs may be stale (a $77,500 down-touch quoted at 81c despite a Sep 2 close near $77,297)
disagreements.verdict: Unverifiable here without the Binance intraday series. The ladder is used only for its implied sigma, which is corroborated by realized vol on the CoinGecko closes, so the estimate does not depend on that rung

calls.reference_class: BTC daily closes ~10.5 days forward versus a strike sitting 0.85% above spot, in a ~33-40% annualized realized-vol regime
